summary: Address code smell: Shotgun Surgery: executor locals in koru queue ticket parsing

delivery.outcome: Clear the code2llm Shotgun Surgery smell for the variable 'executor' in src/koru/queue/ticket.py (planfile ticket PLF-055, reported at line 263) by replacing the generic whole-block local with stage-accurate selections in each of the five functions that declared it: declared_executor (_is_human_executor, the raw executor declaration classified for human-vs-machine kind), executor_kind (_should_skip_deferred_human, the kind string gated by the operator-defer policy) and handler (ticket_command, ticket_api_request, ticket_taskand_request - the executor-declared handler each request builder falls back to: command, endpoint and process URI respectively). The code2llm shotgun-surgery detector groups mutations by (file, variable) and fires at >= 5 scopes; the 'executor' group drops from 5 scopes to 0 and the generic name disappears from the file's mutation set. The new names land at 1, 1 and 3 scopes, all far below the threshold; the next-largest group (inputs, 4 scopes) is untouched. Pure rename plus selection of exactly the piece each stage consumes; no signature, return shape or behavior change; no other file touched.
nonGoals: No behavior, parsing semantics or interface change
No new shared executor-parsing helper; the five reads differ (raw declaration with isinstance guard, kind gate, three handler fallbacks) and a forced abstraction would couple independent stages
No rename of locals in other files that happen to use 'executor' (each is an independent local in its own file scope)

architecture.decision: Stage-accurate local naming only, inside one module. Every function that read the ticket's executor block now names exactly the piece of it that its stage consumes: _is_human_executor keeps the raw declaration (declared_executor) because it must isinstance-guard a missing or malformed block; _should_skip_deferred_human hoists the kind string (executor_kind) it gates on; the three request builders each select the handler (handler) they fall back to. The generic name 'executor' disappears from the file's mutation set entirely. Verified with the installed code2llm DFGExtractor mutation grouping on the file's AST (standalone extract, since ProjectAnalyzer.analyze on copies/worktrees silently yields empty scopes): baseline reports an 'executor' mutation group of exactly 5 scopes - _is_human_executor, _should_skip_deferred_human, ticket_command, ticket_api_request, ticket_taskand_request - matching the ticket's 'spans 5 functions'; after the rename the 'executor' group is empty, the file mutation record count is unchanged at 69 (pure rename), and no (file, variable) group reaches the >= 5 threshold.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; the locals are named executor again and the smell report returns.
